name: Shotsy: Photo Cleaner & Sorter
subtitle: Declutter Camera Roll & Albums
promotional_text: Swipe right to keep, left to toss. Shotsy helps you clear your camera roll a few minutes at a time, and nothing is deleted until you say so.
description:
Make room for the photos you love.

Shotsy turns a huge camera roll into short, easy sorting sessions. Swipe right to keep a photo, left to mark it. Nothing is deleted until you review and confirm.

SWIPE TO SORT
• One photo at a time, big and clear
• Keep, mark, skip, or undo in a tap
• Sort by month or grab a Quick 20 when you have a minute
• Your progress is saved, so you can stop anytime

CLEAN UP SMARTER
• Find similar photos and pick the best one
• Spot exact duplicates, verified byte for byte
• Catch blurry shots and large videos
• Compress big videos into smaller copies and keep the originals

TAME YOUR SCREENSHOTS
• A Screenshot Inbox for receipts, tickets, recipes and more
• Search the text inside your screenshots
• Pin and label the ones you need

STAY ORGANIZED
• Browse your library by month
• Create and edit albums
• Smart Collections that update on their own
• On This Day memories

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Shotsy analyzes your photos on your iPhone. Your photos and screenshot text never leave your device. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos, so you can recover them for about 30 days.

SHOTSY PRO
Sorting is free every day. Shotsy Pro unlocks unlimited sorting, one-tap cleanup, screenshot search and more.
• Weekly: $1.99 per week, renews automatically until canceled
• Lifetime: $19.99, a one-time purchase
Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
